definition.definition: Immutable declarative group identity and source-state requirements.

scientificSources.citation: wwPDB X-ray validation guide, chirality/planarity section, peptide omega definition (snapshot lines1954-1958). Exact source peptide roles required; residue names alone do not establish connectivity.

limitations: Exact supplied alpha-amino-carbonyl / neutral amide / alpha-carbon-carbonyl connectivity; no sequence name, L/D, stereochemistry, trans preference or biological validity inferred.

Glycine, substituted alpha carbons, proline-like N-ring substitution, and cyclic peptide connectivity are not excluded. Non-alpha backbones and charged/resonance-alternate peptide bonds need separately defined roles, not silent normalization.
